candidates.sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT *,row_number() over(partition by id_bioguide order by term_start,term_number,term_id) rn FROM legislators_terms), eligible AS (SELECT l.id_bioguide,r.state FROM legislators l JOIN ranked r ON r.id_bioguide=l.id_bioguide AND r.rn=1 WHERE l.gender='F' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms t WHERE t.id_bioguide=l.id_bioguide AND substr(t.term_start,1,4)||'-12-31'<=t.term_end)), counts AS (SELECT state,count(*) female_legislators FROM eligible GROUP BY state) SELECT state,female_legislators FROM counts WHERE female_legislators=(SELECT max(female_legislators) FROM counts) ORDER BY state
